direct_cause.statement: The last three printed exact Table II values differ from both independent solvers by 0.000221, 0.003136 and 0.038445 while the first four rows agree at printed precision.

root_cause.statement: Protocol-v2 fresh-context review independently confirmed that the stable mismatch is a paper-error candidate after parameter, convergence, implementation and analytic checks. The final publication-side cause remains unresolved without the authors' numerical record or another independent high-precision source, so this is not promoted to a confirmed paper error.

code_fault_assessment.statement: No reproduction-code defect was found: Riccati shooting and a distinct finite-difference eigenproblem agree, both converge with domain/resolution, and analytic/table anchors pass.

checks.statement: All seven epsilon values, the Hamiltonian and Table II comparator are bound to the printed paper parameters.
Changing the shooting boundary from 40 to 30 changes the energies by at most 1.59e-8.
Riccati shooting and sparse finite differences agree within 1.83e-5 over the complete epsilon grid.
The independently evaluated Eq. (11) roots match the printed asymptotic column and the exact first four rows match the paper at its declared precision.

alternative_hypotheses.statement: A shared numerical bug is strongly disfavored because the two solvers use different equations, discretizations and boundary implementations yet agree much more closely with each other than with the last printed rows.
The required fresh-context review has been completed and validates paper-error-candidate status; review absence is no longer an open explanation for the discrepancy.

affected_scope.summary: Only the exact-energy column of Table II at epsilon 1e-5, 1e-6 and 1e-7 is affected; the asymptotic column, Fig. 1 trend and every other target pass.
affected_scope.completion: 4/7 printed exact Table II rows agree at declared precision; 3/7 rows remain discrepant and 7/7 asymptotic rows agree.

next_discriminating_test.action: Obtain the authors' original computation record or an independent high-precision published calculation for the final three Table II rows, then distinguish numerical-conditioning, transcription and other publication-side explanations without changing the paper Hamiltonian.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: Resolve the publication-side mechanism while retaining paper-error-candidate status unless external evidence justifies a narrower confirmed explanation.
evidence_to_produce: an archived author computation record or erratum
an independent high-precision source for the same paper-exact boundary-value problem

targets.remaining_gap: Three late exact rows remain a stable probable paper discrepancy pending protocol-v2 fresh review.
